growth_half_life_years_meta.rationale: Rapid but not immediate normalization across architecture cycles.

latent_loading_meta.rationale: Data Center has high exposure to common AI-capex/demand drivers while retaining architecture/customer idiosyncrasy.

terminal_margin_Y5.rationale: Terminal FCF margin normalizes below current H1 level but remains premium due platform/software economics.

terminal_margin_Y8.rationale: Further maturity compression by Y8 while preserving a structurally high cash margin.

half_life_years_meta.rationale: Mature positive margin converges over roughly two years.

shock_sigma_meta.rationale: Widened in v1.0.1 to move normal company/cycle uncertainty into intrinsic calibration rather than Joint Layer; central margin unchanged.

shock_persistence_meta.rationale: Semiconductor/platform margin shocks persist but mean-revert.

lower_bound_meta.rationale: Severe but still profitable scaled-platform lower bound absent a different state vector.

upper_bound_meta.rationale: Caps unrealistic FCF extrapolation from temporary working-capital/cycle effects.

multiple.rationale: Premium near-term multiple while D4 demand remains strong, with explicit normalization range.
Aligned with NVDA Reverse Valuation terminal multiple range.
Further mature-platform multiple compression by Y8.
Fallback only for extreme negative-FCF paths.

factor_correlations_meta.rationale: AI demand, cash margin and valuation are related but not perfectly synchronized across architecture/cycle paths.

default_loading_meta.rationale: Strong common AI/semiconductor factors with meaningful company-specific architecture execution.

annualized_sigma_meta.rationale: High-beta semiconductor mega-cap path volatility; used only for model-dependent max drawdown.

valuation_mean_reversion_half_life_years.rationale: Liquid mega-cap valuation dislocations mean-revert faster than younger AI-infrastructure names.

discount_rate_meta.rationale: Inherited from NVDA Reverse Valuation calibration base case.

perturbations_meta.formula: local robustness v1.1.2: sigma_equiv=(Q84-Q16)/2; growth sigma=base-revenue-weighted RMS of segment initial_growth sigma_equiv; margin sigma=Y5 margin sigma_equiv (or sqrt(ocf^2+capex^2) for decomposition); multiple sigma=log-space sigma_equiv of Y5 multiple; local shift=0.25*sigma with ceilings 10pp growth, 5pp margin, 20% multiple; correlation remains ±0.15

persistence_meta.rationale: Architecture transition/supply/customer execution persistence across adjacent quarters.
